name: video_to_gif
description: Make an animated GIF (or animated WebP, which is much smaller, when the output ends in .webp) from a part of a video, using an optimised colour palette for clean results. Choose start and end/duration (up to 60 s), frame rate and width.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

start.description: Start of the clip. Default the beginning. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

end.description: End of the clip. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

duration.description: Clip length instead of end. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. Use .gif (default) or .webp. Default: next to the input as <name>_anim.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
